candidates.title: ETCInfer: An Energy-efficient Thermal-aware Cooling-joint Scheduler for LLM Inference in AI Datacenters
candidates.reason: Systems-level inference scheduler jointly controlling datacenter cooling setpoint, GPU frequency, and micro-batch size using telemetry-calibrated thermal/latency models. Reports up to 33.1% total job-energy reduction and 92.9% lower thermal-throttle exposure while maintaining SLO violation below 0.7%; useful adjacent scheduling/resource-control lineage.
